metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · Wednesday
metas.description: Follows Wednesday Addams' years as a student, when she attempts to master her emerging psychic ability, thwart a killing spree, and solve the mystery that embroiled her parents.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Moon Knight
metas.description: Steven Grant discovers he's been granted the powers of an Egyptian moon god. But he soon finds out that these newfound powers can be both a blessing and a curse to his troubled life.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2022 · Andor
metas.description: In an era filled with danger, deception, and intrigue, Cassian Andor embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a Rebel hero.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · The Sandman
metas.description: Upon escaping after decades of imprisonment by a mortal wizard, Dream, the personification of dreams, sets about to reclaim his lost equipment.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · 3 Body Problem
metas.description: A fateful decision made in 1960s China reverberates in the present, where a group of scientists partner with a detective to confront an existential planetary threat.

metas.name: ★ 4.3 · 2024 · The Acolyte
metas.description: An investigation into a shocking crime spree pits a respected Jedi Master against a dangerous warrior from his past. As more clues emerge, they travel down a dark path where sinister forces reveal all is not what it seems…

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Ahsoka
metas.description: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, former Jedi Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.
